phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase C2 — F21 External Instrument Bridge
identity_tested: W1 F21(holder) = W1 F2(holder) - materialized W1 F2M(holder)
scientific_interpretation: QSA publishes total-economy W1 F2 and W1 F21 controls for Romania, but it does not publish the holder-specific W1 F2 series required to apply F2-F2M separately for H/C/F/G/BNR.
The already materialized holder-specific W1 F2M deposits values cannot identify holder-specific W1 F21 without matching holder-specific total F2.
The aggregate identity is insufficient to allocate the published W1 F21 total across resident holders.

The corrected liability-control reader confirms that total W0 F21 liabilities and BNR W0 F21 liabilities are both published at 154429.76 million RON for 2025-Q4 and 13750.66 million RON for 2025 flow; this does not solve the holder allocation.
limitation: The exact QSA instrument bridge fails because its required holder-specific total-F2 source series are absent. No share or residual allocation is permitted.

next_gate.name: BPS/BOP external-sector sector-structure audit
next_gate.purpose: Test whether ECB BPS / BOP-IIP provides external currency-and-deposits assets at sector granularity compatible with RMD H/C/F/G/BNR and whether BPM6/ESA definition differences can be reconciled explicitly.
required_sector_probe: S12T/S122 monetary financial institutions other than central bank
S12M/S12O other financial corporations where published
S1M households and NPISH where published
prohibited: treating BPS F2 as definitionally identical to QSA F2 without a documented BPM6/ESA bridge
mixing EUR and RON observations without an explicit official conversion bridge
using reserve-assets F2 as a substitute for all central-bank other-investment F2
promoting total F2 or behavioural closure
